scenario: WIBTA for telling my sister’s husband he’s a jerk only because he told me I’ve put on weight? | I used to have a pretty slim body last year and hit the gym several times a week that time. I had plenty of free time to do that and I was really motivated to have a healthy lifestyle. After the summer of 2018, I had to move out to another city and live alone. I couldn’t make any friends there, I felt extremely alone on some days and, apart from that, I hated what I was studying at college. I didn’t know how to handle these endless moments of loneliness (combined with a and I just started to eat a lot as a coping mechanism: I ate 4-5 times a day, fast-food every week and an exaggerated amount of sweets and chocolate daily. There’s no wonder I’ve gained around 10 kilos in less than 6 months. I feel very guilty for this and I wish I had motivation and energy for going to the gym, but I feel so tired every day. I barely do my chores or my homework when I have a good day, but during the other ones I simply stay in bed and wasting my time. Of course, my family noticed I’m fat and I have a lot of acne on my face due to unhealthy food. Having to accept rude and blunt comments is what bothers me the most. My sister’s husband keep asking me how many kilos I have (“70, 75 or more?”), why I don’t go to the gym, why I eat so much and many other “why”s and “what”s. It’s clear he asks these in an arrogant manner, as he’s a bodybuilder and have a very clean diet. I easily sense when someone just wants to make me feel bad. WIBTA for telling me he’s a jerk and he should stop with this bullshit because it affects me? I know fat acceptance is a bullshit and you shouldn’t encourage someone to tolerate their harmful lifestyle, but it does affect me.
